headline: Stochastic gene regulation links epigenetic landscapes to cell-state heterogeneity
label: Stochastic Gene Regulatory Dynamics
summary: Recent preprints couple stochastic expression models with population renewal, differentiable GRN optimization, and self-renewal network analysis.
synthesis: The common thread is the use of explicit gene regulatory network models to connect stochastic expression to cell-state heterogeneity and differentiation. The unified PDE-integral framework (arXiv:2611.19257) couples stochastic gene-regulatory dynamics with population renewal to define a dynamic Waddington landscape. The jaxgrn framework (arXiv:2611.20172) applies differentiable programming to optimize thousands of gene regulatory networks end-to-end on GPUs using stochastic simulation. Two bioRxiv preprints examine network topology directly: feedback loops are shown to restore heterogeneous expression from homogeneous populations during self-renewal, and positive-cycle tangles with mutual inhibition enable hierarchical differentiation patterns. What is new is the joint treatment of population-level renewal, landscape geometry, and large-scale network optimization, though all four items are preprints.
